description: This file defines the TensorVariable class and related classes for tracking tensor operations, properties, and methods during Dynamo's tracing process in PyTorch. It handles interaction with tensor attributes, method calls, and connected external references, serving as a core component for symbolic tracing of tensors within Dynamo.

classes.name: TensorVariable
classes.description: A class for tracking and representing torch.Tensor objects during Dynamo's symbolic execution, including their properties, method calls, attribute access, and interactions with external modules.

classes.name: SymNodeVariable
classes.description: Represents a symbolic scalar, either int, float or bool. Used for symbolic size computation, float_tensor.item(), or unspecialized float inputs.

classes.name: NumpyNdarrayVariable
classes.description: Represents a np.ndarray backed by torch.Tensor via torch._numpy.ndarray, for tensor.numpy() calls.

classes.name: UnspecializedPythonVariable
classes.description: A 1-element tensor representing an unspecialized Python float/int.

classes.name: FakeItemVariable
classes.description: An unspecialized Python variable that prevents access to the underlying raw value, used for item() on FakeTensor.

classes.name: TensorSubclassVariable
classes.description: Handles subclass tensor objects, especially custom torch.nn.Module subclasses with overridden __new__ or __init__.

classes.name: UntypedStorageVariable
classes.description: Represents untyped storage associated with a tensor, allowing method interactions like size and resize.

classes.name: DataPtrVariable
classes.description: Represents the data pointer of a tensor, allowing retrieval of the tensor's data pointer.
